Name: Targeted Bait Downcycler
Author: cardiacman
Description:
[b][color=#d4d4d8]Description[/color][/b]
[color=#D4D4D8]Got leftover targeted bait? Turn it into regular bait with a simple crafting recipe.
[b]Installation instructions[/b][/color]

[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download and unzip the mod.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Place the[/color]

[code]TargetedBaitDowncycler[/code][color=#D4D4D8]folder in your Stardew Valley[/color]

[code]Mods[/code][color=#D4D4D8]folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]Main features[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Converts 1 targeted bait into 1 regular bait.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Accepts targeted bait for any fish.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Adds the “Downcycle Targeted Bait” recipe at Fishing level 2.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Uses the standard bait icon in the crafting menu.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Move bait from your rod into your inventory before crafting. If you’re carrying several varieties, store any you want to keep—the recipe can use any targeted bait.
[b]Requirements[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley 1.6 or newer[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI 4.0 or newer[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Content Patcher 2.0 or newer[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]Shout outs[/b]
Thanks to the SMAPI and Content Patcher teams for making mods like this possible.[/color]

Manifest.Name: Targeted Bait Downcycler
Manifest.Description: Turn leftover targeted bait into regular bait. Unlocks at Fishing level 2.
Manifest.Author: cardiacman
